# Why Forward Kinematics (FK) Can Still Be Called Inverse Kinematics (IK) Before Script Calls

> **Current answer:** The project contributor explicitly states that the inverse kinematics (IK) is 'optimized based on forward kinematics (FK):' the optimizer adjusts the joint variables, FK calculates the current joint corresponding body/joint position, and the error between these positions and the target is used to drive the optimization. Therefore, the code contains an FK model that does not equal only the forward calculation.

## Priority diagnostics

- Distinguish between the forward kinematics (FK) used for pose error calculation and the inverse kinematics (IK) used for solving joint variables.

## Possible causes

- Treating FK error calculation in optimal IK as a pure FK process.

## Effective fixes

- Understand the script as an optimized inverse kinematics (IK) based on Forward Kinematics (FK).
